method: Read original vendor documentation, original model card and author repositories through web browsing. No model calls. Third-party SEO mirrors excluded.

sources.title: TypeSafe: Introducing System One Models & Jev
sources.nature: vendor description and vendor-reported performance, not an AI4Loc reproduction
sources.supports: Vendor names RLCD, parallel typed outputs and specialized architecture; does not establish exact equivalence to Laya or our causal Qwen adaptation.

sources.title: SGLang Decision models
sources.nature: current implementation documentation; historical experiments remain pinned to their recorded runtime
sources.supports: Generic generation model option probabilities read from next-token scores; independent questions; does not require dedicated weights; not proof of calibrated domain correctness.

sources.title: Perplexity pplx-decider-v1-27b model card
sources.nature: original model publisher; only v1 was tested here
sources.supports: Dedicated decision weights fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B. No kernel-diagnostic superiority follows from general benchmark claims.

sources.title: sshh12/nanojev
sources.nature: author-described hypothetical reconstruction; README main observed on check date, not executed in this study
sources.supports: Distinct Qwen3.5-4B-Base/LoRA/pointer-head design with supervised training, fitted temperature and shared-state cache forks. Self-reported approximately 90.7 percent is from the author's own benchmark, not our 87 kernel cases.

sources.title: NandhaKishorM/laya fixed reference
sources.nature: original open-source implementation, fixed version used as project reference
sources.supports: Encoder-based typed decision models and RLCD-style probability training. Shared terminology does not establish access to or faithful reproduction of proprietary Jev recipe.

limitations: Nanojev current author README was read, but full training script fetch failed; no claim of complete code audit or reproduction.
No externally reported benchmark is merged with local measurements.
No vendor certification or proof of internal architectural equivalence was found in the reviewed material.
